definitions.explanation: A hard green (sometimes white or lilac) stone prized for jewelry and carving. Japan's national stone; jade from the Itoigawa area of Niigata has been worked since prehistoric times.

examples.japanese: {翡翠|ひすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{翡翠|ひすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネックレス→ネックレス：04539_nekkuresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a jade necklace from my grandmother.

examples.japanese: {新潟県|にいがたけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糸魚川|いといがわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{翡翠|ひすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}える→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦ことがある→ことがある：32886_kotogaaru⟧。
examples.english: At Itoigawa in Niigata Prefecture, you can still sometimes find jade on the beach.

notes:
Often written ヒスイ. The same kanji {翡翠|かわせみ} also spell ⟦カワセミ→カワセミ：32263_kawasemi⟧, the kingfisher, whose bright blue-green feathers gave the stone its name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {翡翠色|ひすいいろ}: jade green
- {翡翠|ひすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勾玉|まがたま}: a comma-shaped jade bead of ancient Japan
- {本翡翠|ほんひすい}: genuine jade (as opposed to imitations)
